title: SlopeCheckRequest
description: Server-side confirmation that a circular zone satisfies a maximum terrain slope. The web front previews the threshold on pre-computed slope tiles; this request asks the science service to re-check the zone on the full-resolution DEM. Public units: degrees, meters. Latitude is planetocentric; longitude is east-positive in [-180, 180). Slope is computed on the DEM grid (20 m baseline for LOLA ldem_85s_20m), NOT at lander-footprint scale.

center_latitude_deg.description: Planetocentric latitude of the zone centre, degrees. Must lie inside the DEM coverage (currently 85S-90S), otherwise status = out_of_coverage.

center_longitude_deg.description: East-positive longitude of the zone centre, degrees, in [-180, 180). Ignored-but-valid at the exact pole.

radius_m.description: Zone radius on the surface, meters. Lower bound = one DEM pixel; upper bound keeps the request cheap.

max_slope_deg.description: Maximum acceptable slope, degrees from local horizontal.

required_fraction.description: Fraction of valid DEM pixels in the zone that must be at or below max_slope_deg for verdict = pass. 1.0 = every pixel.

max_nodata_fraction.description: Largest acceptable fraction of no-data pixels in the zone. Above it, verdict = insufficient_data (never silently treated as flat).
